{"metadata":{"description":"Agent 会话的时光机。 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件,把 append-only 会话日志变成可交互的回放:可播放的时间线 + 逐步 token 账单、安全审计视图、fork 血缘树、双会话对比 —— 全部内嵌在 Harness 的 Web UI 里。","id":"gh:1336849561","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-replay","slug":"MingoZhou/dsh-replay","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Agent 会话的时光机。 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件,把 append-only 会话日志变成可交互的回放:可播放的时间线 + 逐步 token 账单、安全审计视图、fork 血缘"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"树、双会话对比 —— 全部内嵌在 Harness 的 Web UI 里。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-replay"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Read-only session review for DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Cost · Audit · Fork tree · Compare · Shareable HTML — **no model calls, no token spend.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"简体中文 · Live demo · Install · Why not Trajectory? · Privacy"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Desktop one-click install:** **Plugins → Add plugin → `@mingozhou/dsh-replay` → Install** → rest"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"art.
> Web/source: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add …`."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"15-second demo · sample sessions · the exported HTML is offline and read-only
GIF fallback · full de"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"-second demo · sample sessions · the exported HTML is offline and read-only
GIF fallback · full demo"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **“Replay” here means read-only.** dsh-replay never re-sends a session to a model, never writes th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e log, and never spends tokens. It parses the append-only session log and renders it. See FAQ.
>
> *"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"*Historical note (preserving the original claim).** ~~DeepSeek Harness keeps a beautiful append-only"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" log where everything that reached the model is reconstructible — but ships no viewer for it. **dsh-"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"replay is that viewer.**~~
> That was true when this project started in **2026-08**. Since **DSH 0.2"},{"id":"p8s6","text":".1-rc.2**, the official Web UI ships the **Trajectory (轨迹)** view, which covers the current session'"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"s event ledger. dsh-replay is now the viewer for the **archive**: every session, cost, Windows-aware"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" audit, fork/compare, and redacted standalone export. Details below."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why not Trajectory?"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Trajectory is excellent for **the session you are in**: a live ledger, timing overview, per-record t"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"okens, thinking, system prompt, virtual scrolling. If that is all you need, use it. dsh-replay is fo"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"r **after the session ends**, and for the questions Trajectory does not answer:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| | Official Trajectory | dsh-replay |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Scope | current session | **all sessions + archive dashboard** |
| Timeline | native, live, virtua"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"lized | playback, reasoning, system prompt, tool summaries |
| Cost | token counts | **per-model cos"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"t, USD/CNY, editable price table** |
| Risk | — | **Windows-aware audit, baseline suppression, secre"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"t redaction** |
| Lineage | — | **fork tree + exact divergence + cost/risk deltas** |
| Sharing | ra"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"w session ZIP | **redacted, standalone, interactive HTML** |
| Data | in the session | **local archi"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ve; no telemetry** |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The two coexist. dsh-replay does not replace Trajectory; it answers “what happened across all of thi"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s, what did it cost, what was risky, and how do I show someone?”"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| 📊 **Archive dashboard** | Every session on this machine: month/all-time tokens, estimated cost, hi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"gh-risk findings, search by title/id/workspace. |
| 💰 **Per-model cost** | Cache-aware totals, a per"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"-model breakdown, USD/CNY, and an editable price table. No more charging every token at one model's "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"rate. |
| 🛡️ **Windows-aware audit** | `pwsh`/PowerShell/`cmd` as well as bash; destructive deletes,"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" credential reads, exfil, persistence and policy changes. Initial permission/sandbox state is treate"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"d as baseline, not a finding. |
| 🔐 **Secret redaction** | Common API keys, `.env` assignments, priv"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ate keys, home paths. The export dialog shows the redaction count before you share. |
| 📤 **Shareabl"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"e HTML** | One session baked into a single offline `.html`: no install, no network, no model. Ideal "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"for bug reports and post-mortems. |
| 🌿 **Fork tree** | Full lineage, subagents, fork boundaries, cl"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ick-through. |
| ⚖️ **Compare** | Any two sessions: stats, tool mix, cost/risk deltas, full-lineage "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"relation, and the first differing event on each side. |
| ⏪ **Timeline** | 1–16× playback, reasoning"},{"id":"p15s12","text":", system prompt, search, type filters, keyboard navigation, tool summaries instead of raw JSON. |
| "},{"id":"p15s13","text":"🌏 **English / 中文** | The app UI switches language; DSH-injected view labels remain whatever the host"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"/ 中文** | The app UI switches language; DSH-injected view labels remain whatever the host provides. |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What changed in 0.4.2"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"This is the “still alive” maintenance release, focused on trust and first-run:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Audit correctness:** `pwsh`/PowerShell/`cmd`, Windows destructive commands, credential reads and"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" exfiltration; initial `permission/preset` / `sandbox/mode` no longer raises a finding; routine writ"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"es/network reads no longer flood the list.
- **Cost correctness:** per-model totals; mixed-model ses"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"sions are priced separately; editable price table; USD/CNY.
- **Share safely:** redaction preview + "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"count + size estimate; unredacted export is an explicit opt-in; exported viewer has no empty Forks/C"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ompare tabs.
- **Actually smaller:** client bundle **2.0 MB → 232 KB**; mascot **1.4 MB → 73 KB**; R"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"EADME GIF **28.8 MB → 164 KB**; 15-second WebP **116 KB**.
- **More useful timeline:** reasoning, sy"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"stem prompt, model selection, tool summaries, keyboard navigation, selected-event preservation under"},{"id":"p18s9","text":" filters.
- **Archive dashboard:** every session, month/all-time, tokens, cost, risk, search, worksp"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ace filter.
- **Privacy/security:** loopback-only API by default; secret redaction; PRIVACY.md and S"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ECURITY.md.
- **Compatibility:** `engines.dsh`; targeted at DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (the `sessionQuer"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"y` contract was checked against the running app; the UI was verified in demo mode)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Component | Tested / required |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| DSH Desktop | **0.2.1-rc.2** — target / API contract checked |
| DSH Web | 0.2.x expected (same `s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"essionQuery` / webServer contract) |
| Node | **22+** |
| Package | `@mingozhou/dsh-replay@0.4.2` |
"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"| Plugin API range | `engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.8` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH moves fast. If a future release breaks the adapter, `npm run demo` still works because the analy"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"sis/UI layers are independent of the host. Open an issue with the DSH version and the failing route."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Privacy and security"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- The plugin reads session logs through `ctx.sessionQuery`; it writes **no session data**.
- The UI "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"calls the **local DSH origin only**; no telemetry, no cloud parser.
- The host API is **loopback-onl"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"y by default** and read-only. `allowRemote` is an explicit opt-in and remains unauthenticated — do n"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ot expose it to a network.
- Exported HTML is self-contained and offline. **Session logs are raw dat"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"a**: the export redacts common credentials, but review the file before sharing.
- Read PRIVACY.md an"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"t redacts common credentials, but review the file before sharing.
- Read PRIVACY.md and SECURITY.md."}],"truncated":true}
